(I did not have access to a smart phone so could not access the video for instructions, so you might want to address this.) Once the drawings were figured out, assembly was quick and easy. 
I purchased my first Weber kettle 15 years ago and used it extensively. But it needed new wheels, new charcoal grate, new cooking grate, new ash pan, and new blades for the ash scraper, so it was time to replace it. The many improvements made over this time period were excellent and much appreciated by this user.
My only issue with my new master touch is that years ago I purchased a rotisserie kit for my Weber kettle. Yesterday I rotisserie grilled a roast. I discovered that the rotisserie collar which fit my old Weber perfectly did not fit my new one as well. It was a bit smaller and the least bit of uneven pressure on top of the collar, such as replacing the lid and letting one edge of the lid touch the top rim first, would cause it to slip down. Once in walking around the grill my foot hit the front leg and this slight jarring caused the collar to slip down almost 2 inches. Has the circumference of the kettle bowl changed? If so, is there any way to compensate, or do I now have to purchase an new rotisserie collar?  Other than this, my new Master-Touch is perfect.

!

Results.ReviewText:
This is by far the best purchase I’ve made during the 2020 quarantine. And probably in the last 10 years. For the last 15 years I’ve been cooking on a Weber Smokey Joe. We realized that it’s just too tiny for a family of four. But still love my SJ. I absolutely love this kettle grill! And I especially love the color. I even think the extra $30 for the Spring Green was worth it. I love all the extra features, the char baskets, the gourmet barbecue system grill, the lid bail, the top vent grip, everything is just great. My wife and daughter really love the green color, it makes them smile when they see it on the back patio. So far I’ve done a couple top sirloins, some hotdogs and a six pound bone in pork shoulder that came out absolutely sublime. In fact that pork shoulder is probably the best thing I’ve ever cooked in my life. We’ve been eating pulled pork for the last three days and it’s still just amazing! I cooked that bad boy for eight hours and I could not believe how easy it was to control the temperature by just using the top and bottom vents. I followed the instructions on the Weber website using 72 briquettes (36 in each basket) and 16 lit briquettes. I used two Weber lighter cubes to get the briquettes started in my Weber charcoal chimney. I then used the two char baskets on either side using the modified minion method with eight lit briquettes in each one. On top of those I put two medium sized chunks of oak and to my amazement, for eight hours I did not have to add any briquettes for the entire cook. It maintained temp at 250F give or take for eight hours. Unbelievable!!! I thought long and hard about getting a pellet grill but I feel like the design, the functionality, the aesthetic, the back to basic nature of the Weber kettle grill is just perfect. I feel like I’m actually becoming a better cook (was never really a good cook in the first place) just by having this grill. I wish I could convey in this review how excited I am about my Weber Master Touch in Spring Green. If you’re reading this review it means that you’re seriously considering purchasing one... I would say don’t hesitate, go ahead and pull the trigger. You won’t be disappointed.

*one complaint... One of the holes for the lid bail was drilled too high and didn’t allow the plastic spindle to spin freely or the lid to sit down completely. I had to file that hole down a little bit to drop the lid bail down a quarter inch. Very minor, but still a QC issue that should be looked into.

By the way… I’m using a ThermoPro TP20S wireless meat thermometer. Which I also highly recommend.
Results.Title: Amazing! Best Cooking Implement on the Market!!

Results.ReviewText: Weber is, and has been the best quality and by far, the best performing grill you can own. The quality is second to none! Any serious grilled knows, this is the ultimate. Thank you for building such a wonderful product.
Results.Title: The best grill you can own!

Results.ReviewText: I Absolutely love, love my grill! I just received my wok! Absolutely love it!!!
Results.Title: My BBQ`s are the  est!

Results.ReviewText: Je suis ultra satisfait de la marque Weber. Mon BBQ est à la hauteur de ce que j’ai vu sur YouTube. C’est un BBQ tellement bien fait la chaleur reste dans le BBQ et le couvercle est hyper hermétique. C’est vraiment facile à monter, l’application mobile est vraiment bien faite. Je suis en amour avec Weber, acheté le iGrill2 pour une cuisson parfaite. Je vous aime WEBER
Results.Title: WOW le produit est vraiment HOOOOT

ClientResponses.Response: Hi Benjamin, We are sorry about the vast disappointment with your new grill. We understand that you have already returned this unit however if you have questions or concerns please reach out to us at reviews@weberstephen.com. Thank you.
ClientResponses.Name: Weber grills

Results.ReviewText: I was really looking forward to what would had amounted to be the ownership of my first Weber product. I had did my research and liked the various reviews I had read across various media outlets. However, much to my dismay the grill arrived at my home with a damaged lid therefore, I returned the grill back to Weber.
Results.Title: First Impression Are Always Important

Results.ReviewText: I can’t tell you how much I love this grill and how glad I am that I sprung for the spring green color
Results.Title: Love it
